script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sports
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - DAY

Two TEENAGE BOYS, MIKE and TOM, sit on the sidelines of a bustling gymnasium, surrounded by their classmates engaged in various physical activities. The smell of fresh paint and sweat wafts through the air.

MIKE: (looking around the gym) Man, I'm really gonna miss this place when I graduate.

TOM: (nods) It's got its charm, but you know what I'll miss the most? Our time together, man.

They share a heartfelt smile.

EXT. HIGH SCHOOL FOOTBALL FIELD - NIGHT

Mike, a starting wide receiver, catches a critical pass from their quarterback, securing the win for their team. The crowd goes wild. Mike looks to the sidelines and finds Tom cheering for him.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL CAFETERIA - DAY

Mike and Tom sit together during lunch, surrounded by their classmates, laughing and joking around.

MIKE: (grinning) You'll never guess what I did last night.

TOM: (amused) What? Break curfew and eat a midnight snack?

Mike laughs and shakes his head.

MIKE: No, I joined a local running club.

TOM: (surprised) Really? Why?

MIKE: I've always loved running, but I want to push myself further. I want to be better.

TOM: (proudly) I know you will, man.

EXT. LOCAL RUNNING TRACK - MORNING

Mike shows up for his first running club practice, nervous but determined. He sees Tom there, already warming up.

MIKE: (breathlessly) Hey, Tom! What's up?

TOM: (grinning) Hey, Mike! Welcome to the running club. I'm glad you could make it.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL LIBRARY - DAY

Mike and Tom sit together, engrossed in a book about running techniques.

MIKE: (excitedly) This technique is amazing. I think it could really help me improve.

TOM: (smiling) I believe in you, man. Keep at it.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - NIGHT

Tom helps Mike practice the new running technique during a private session.

TOM: (encouragingly) You got this, man. Keep going.

MIKE: (struggling) I'm giving it my all, but it's just not clicking yet.

TOM: (kindly) Don't worry, Mike. We all have our off days. Keep trying and you'll get it.

EXT. HIGH SCHOOL FOOTBALL FIELD - EVENING

Mike, Tom, and their friends participate in a friendly football scrimmage. Despite some rough patches, they work together and support each other, ultimately coming out on top.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - NIGHT

The graduation ceremony approaches, and Mike reflects on his time at the high school. He looks over to the sidelines, where Tom cheers him on, just as he always had.

MIKE: (whispering to himself) I'll never forget the memories we made here, Tom.

As the crowd cheers for their accomplishments, Mike and Tom exchange a meaningful glance, knowing that their friendship will last a lifetime.

FADE OUT.
